Can I reroute the package to a different address?

We’re not able to reroute packages from our side. If your order has already shipped, you’ll need to contact the carrier directly to see what options they offer. If your order hasn’t shipped yet and you want to request an address update, I’d be happy to escalate this matter to our team for further review.
